Hi Anneb5

I believe your post was directed at my post. I didn't mean to confuse you. One thing you will see with QM's is that the shoulder (H or L depending on QM direction) doesn't need to be in the same time period. We can have a big delay before coming back to the QM level. I'm also still learning so maybe Les Paul can give us some feedback.
